Name: Advanced Special Attacks
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
This mod uses the weapon-type feature of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7886]Advanced Melee Framework[/url] to provide three new special attack skills for each type of weapon (swords, clubs, and daggers).

The first new skill for each weapon type is available at combat level four, second at level seven, and third at level ten.

Skills for each weapon type are as follows:

[b]Swords

[/b][list=1]
[*]quick slash in all four directions
[*]quick slash in all four directions plus magic projectiles in four directions that do 3x weapon damage
[*]quick slash in all four directions twice plus magic projectiles in eight directions that do 6x weapon damage
[/list]

[b]Clubs

[/b][list=1]
[*]power slam plus a single lightning projectile that does 2x weapon damage
[*]power slam plus three lightning projectiles that do 3x weapon damage
[*]power slam plus five lightning projectiles that do 6x weapon damage

[/list]
[b]Daggers

[/b][list=1]
[*]quick lunge then rapid stab attack then quick retreat
[*]quick lunge then rapid stab attack plus three throwing daggers that do 3x weapon damage then quick retreat
[*]quick lunge then rapid stab attack plus five throwing daggers that do 6x weapon damage then quick retreat

[/list]
Here's a video showing these attacks (max level) in comparison to the vanilla special attacks:

[youtube]rI-hZUWUv5g[/youtube]

And here's a video showing me clumsily defeating a bug boss with them:

By default these skills override the existing skills once you reach the required level. You can edit the config.json for Advanced Melee Framework to alternatively require holding down a modifier key to switch to this mod's special attack.


[size=4][b]Technical[/b][/size]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7886]Advanced Melee Framework[/url] (which uses Harmony).

Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6338]Mod Updater[/url]﻿ for automatic updates.

Code is at [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods[/url].
